{
  "description": "Halloween words for the spinner that animates while Claude works: Conjuring, Brewing, Haunting, Summoning and more replace the built-in verbs. Uses the spinnerVerbs setting (mode replace). Remove the spinnerVerbs key to get the defaults back.",
  "spinnerVerbs": {
    "mode": "replace",
    "verbs": [
      "Conjuring",
      "Brewing",
      "Haunting",
      "Summoning",
      "Carving",
      "Possessing",
      "Cackling",
      "Lurking",
      "Bewitching",
      "Hexing",
      "Exhuming",
      "Spellcasting"
    ]
  }
}
